description: This file contains common utilities and functions for orchestrating Android-Cuttlefish testing environments, including Docker container management, service setup, bug report collection, log verification, and CVD creation.

classes.name: DockerHelper
classes.description: Helper class encapsulating Docker client operations such as loading images, running/removing containers, executing commands, and fetching logs.

classes.name: DockerExecExitCodeError
classes.description: Error type representing non-zero exit codes from Docker exec commands.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes the Android host orchestrator service in a Docker container and returns a TestContext.

methods.name: waitUntilServiceIsUp
methods.description: Polls a URL until the service responds with HTTP 200 OK or times out.

methods.name: NewDockerHelper
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DockerHelper with Docker client initialized.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of Docker resources, including logs, containers, and images, based on provided context.

methods.name: DownloadHostBugReport
methods.description: Triggers the creation of a bug report zip from the host orchestrator service and verifies its validity.

methods.name: UploadAndExtract
methods.description: Uploads a file to the remote host, extracts it, and waits for the extraction operation to complete.

methods.name: VerifyLogsEndpoint
methods.description: Checks the accessibility of logs endpoints for a specific group and device name.

methods.name: CreateCVDFromUserArtifactsDir
methods.description: Creates a CVD (Cuttlefish Virtual Device) configuration from a user artifacts directory using the host orchestrator service.
